name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:fix. Changelog (last 3): 7.316.0 — Delegation is a plugin-owned fact: pending-question.js isDelegated(root) reads the spec-delegated marker in the lane's private git dir (new 'mark' subcommand, the fan-out's first worker command) or the lane's branch in the fan-out table, never CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION — the parent session carries that variable too, so the orchestrator read itself as a worker and its merge step printed MERGE_READY. 7.315.0 — Add /spec:fanout — one session runs the lanes: a driver-stepped fan-out over worktree-isolated sub-agents with batched question relay, serial merge with a gate after each, and one rendered report. 7.314.0 — red-check no longer reports a hard broken-pin for a SHALL CONTINUE TO pin that ends → rewrites: a rewrites disposition is never sanctioned green at the whole-file level, so the whole-file and per-test arms demand the same red (prax-app 20261103/01). A green rewrite of such a pin is now unsanctioned-green even without testNameFilter. The spec template's pin sentence names the exception.
